usage: New industry photographs for Targeted Waste Streams, replacing the presentation's stock photographs.
shared_direction: Original square photorealistic industrial editorial photographs, natural neutral colors, diffused daylight, centered composition suitable for circular crops; no text, labels, logos, watermarks, collages or graphic overlays.

images.prompt: A new overhead-oblique composition of four well-used open metal paint cans in a workshop containment tray, showing slate-blue, off-white and muted green residual paint, dried splashes on rims and one wooden stirrer. Industrial recycling feedstock, tactile metal and liquid textures, softly blurred concrete workshop background.

Macro industrial material photograph of fine matte black carbon-black pellets and powder mounded in a shallow stainless-steel sample tray. Dense small granular texture, a metal scoop partly visible at the rear, softly blurred processing equipment. It must read as carbon-black raw material, not shiny coal boulders or food.

Close industrial photograph of glossy black printing ink stretching from the tip of a raised metal mixing blade into a small steel ink pot on an ink-stained workbench. A few subtle cyan and magenta pigment stains nearby, blurred printing machinery in the background. No packaging brands or readable writing.

Close documentary photograph of discarded generic consumer electronics and product components collected for recycling: coiled black and white cables, a small unbranded plastic appliance housing, circuit-board fragments, and rigid packaging in a shallow sorting bin. New balanced composition, visible signs of use, no branded products or readable labels.

Industrial close-up of viscous brown-black oily sludge in an open rectangular steel receiving tray at a waste-processing facility. Uneven thick surface, subtle reflective oil sheen, small clumps and a collection pipe softly out of focus behind. Realistic, restrained industrial photograph, no dramatic smoke or spills outside containment.

Professional documentary photograph of several sealed unbranded agricultural-chemical HDPE jugs in a clean secondary-containment tray in a farm chemical storage shed. Off-white jugs with green and dark caps, a blurred agricultural sprayer beyond an open doorway, soft green rural background. No food, no visible text or commercial labels, no people.

Industrial documentary photograph of four unbranded blue HDPE chemical jerrycans of differing sizes with white screw caps on a black containment pallet in a processing warehouse. Pipes and steel tanks softly blurred in the background. New tidy staggered arrangement, worn realistic surfaces, no labels or logos.

Natural daylight editorial photograph of mixed non-hazardous industrial plant waste at a recycling yard: weathered wood offcuts, rigid plastic scraps, cardboard and metal remnants in a contained sorting bay, with part of a yellow wheel loader visible behind. New elevated three-quarter composition, cloudy sky, no people, no brands or text.
